nodes.label: Chrono_core Precompiled Header
nodes.rationale: Chrono_core has ~500 translation units that nearly all include the core linear-algebra headers plus STL streams/containers; Build Insights shows Eigen dominates template instantiation and ChMatrix.h is the single most-included header. ChMatrix.h is the PCH anchor rather than a bare Eigen include because it defines EIGEN_MATRIXBASE_PLUGIN/EIGEN_SPARSEMATRIX_PLUGIN first, reproducing Chrono's exact Eigen configuration, and transitively covers ChArchive.h/ChArchiveASCII.h. Scope is PRIVATE so consumers are not forced onto it; ChCorePCH.h is __cplusplus-guarded so C sources get an empty PCH.

nodes.label: Chrono_core Thrust Device System (OMP/CPP)
nodes.rationale: Chrono_core selects THRUST_DEVICE_SYSTEM_OMP when OpenMP is enabled and THRUST_DEVICE_SYSTEM_CPP otherwise, and keeps both definitions PRIVATE.

nodes.label: SYSTEM Include Split for Third-Party Headers
nodes.rationale: Include directories that resolve only third-party headers (bullet, chrono_thirdparty, HACDv2) are kept in a separate list so they can be marked SYSTEM; warnings raised inside those headers are then suppressed both in Chrono and in downstream projects.
